claims.claim: Sony PlayStation 5 console and controller available.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a white PlayStation console and a DualSense-style wired controller, but do not show the exact PS5 model/version (e.g., disc vs digital) or any readable model label.

claims.claim: It comes with FIFA disc game and accessories.
claims.evidence: Witness report mentions a small accessory bag/pack near the controller, but no FIFA disc or specific accessories are shown in the described photos.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working.
claims.evidence: Photos do not include a power-on/HDMI output test, fan/noise check, overheating indicators, or port-by-port functionality proof.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: Photos show a controller and a small accessory bag/pack, but do not show original pads/receipt documents.

risks.risk: Console model/version mismatch (PS4 vs PS5, disc vs digital) which changes value and compatibility.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console model label/serial sticker and the back ports area showing the exact model (and whether it has a disc drive).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic white PlayStation console with unknown model/version (worst-case value for the least desirable/least confirmed variant).

risks.risk: Not fully functional (HDMI output, disc drive (if disc), USB/ports, power supply stability).
risks.proof: A short video clip of power-on to the home screen and an HDMI display test; if disc model, insert and play a disc for a few seconds.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: treat as needing testing/possible faults).

risks.risk: Overheating or fan issues not visible in still photos.
risks.proof: A clip showing the console running a game/menu for several minutes with no shutdown and (if possible) a fan noise check.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential overheating risk (worst-case: discount heavily for possible thermal/fan problems).

risks.risk: Controller condition issues (stick drift, button responsiveness, cable/port wear).
risks.proof: A video showing controller inputs responding in a test screen (e.g., moving sticks/camera) and a quick button press test; also show the cable connection firmly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as controller condition unknown (worst-case: treat as needing replacement/repair).

risks.risk: Included items not actually present (FIFA disc, HDMI cable, charging cable, original pads, receipt).
risks.proof: A laid-out photo of every included item with labels (FIFA disc visible, cables shown, receipt shown).
risks.if_unproven: Price excluding unverified extras (worst-case: only what is clearly shown).

risks.risk: Account/console status problems (linked accounts, bans, not factory reset).
risks.proof: A clip of the console settings showing it is factory reset / ready for setup (no prior account prompts) and no ban indicators.
risks.if_unproven: Price as account status unknown (worst-case: assume buyer may need to handle account reset/verification).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the console model label/serial sticker (to confirm PS5 model/version and disc vs digital).
Short video: power-on and HDMI output to the home screen.
If disc model: video inserting and running the FIFA disc for a few seconds.
Video showing controller input responsiveness (sticks + buttons) and that the cable/connection works reliably.
Laid-out photo of all included items: FIFA disc, all cables (power/HDMI/controller), and any accessories; show the UK receipt if claimed.
response.reason: The witness confirms a white PlayStation console and a DualSense-style wired controller, but the key value drivers (exact PS5 model/version, disc drive, working tests, and included FIFA/receipt) are not proven by the described photos. Without those, a worst-case price would be too speculative.
